metadata.author: Phan Nguyễn Mai Phương
metadata.parquet_writer: PyArrow on driver; Spark write_seconds includes toArrow collection
metadata.scope: local replicated data; no distributed-cluster throughput claim

sql.query:
SELECT s.engine_id, s.n_cycles, t.cycle, t.rul
FROM engine_summary AS s
JOIN train_targets AS t
  ON t.split = s.split AND t.engine_id = s.engine_id
WHERE s.split = 'train' AND s.engine_id = 1
  AND t.cycle IN (1, 100, 192);
